classifications.rationale: The President immediately assigns specified presidential functions to the Secretary of State, subject to consultation; this is an internal delegation, while any legal consequences arise only from later exercise of those functions.
classifications.evidence: I hereby delegate to the Secretary of State the functions vested in the President

classifications.rationale: The President immediately delegates specified statutory functions to the Secretary of State without directing any particular later legal outcome.
classifications.evidence: I hereby delegate to the Secretary of State the functions vested in the President

classifications.rationale: The President immediately assigns Treasury authority to exercise specified sanctions-related functions when the stated prerequisite is met, but does not itself select or impose a sanction.
classifications.evidence: I hereby delegate to the Secretary of the Treasury, in consultation with the Secretary of State, the functions vested in the President

classifications.rationale: The President preserves an earlier internal delegation arrangement for implementing the prior statutory provisions; the segment does not itself impose a substantive legal consequence.
classifications.evidence: shall remain in effect with regard to implementation under section 102(h)(2) of CISADA

classifications.rationale: The President immediately distributes statutory functions among executive officials and defines the memorandum’s future statutory references, without compelling a specified exercise of those functions or itself granting waivers, imposing sanctions, or applying prohibitions.
classifications.evidence: I hereby delegate functions vested in the President by CISADA
